description_en: Configures monitoring and alerting to monitor the latency and exception status of a synchronization task
description_zh: 配置监控报警，来监控同步作业的延迟和异常状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts configure-synchronization-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtskxz1170c10p0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureSynchronizationJobAlert

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSynchronizationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：

Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the latency status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the ErrorAlertStatus parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控延迟状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和ErrorAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个
parameters.name: delay_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for latency alerts. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,).

Note
This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and only Chinese mainland phone numbers are supported. You can specify up to 10 phone numbers.
China site (Chinese mainland) does not support phone alerts on the China site. You can configure alert rules for DTS tasks only in the CloudMonitor console
parameters.help_zh:
延迟报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。

说明
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入 10 个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持通过云监控平台为 DTS 任务设置报警规则
parameters.name: delay_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the exception status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DelayAlertStatus parameter.
After you enable exception status monitoring, an alert is triggered when an exception is detected
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控异常状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和DelayAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个。
开启监控异常状态功能后，如果检测到异常，将触发报警
parameters.name: error_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for exception alerts. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,).

Note
This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and only Chinese mainland phone numbers are supported. You can specify up to 10 phone numbers.
The China site does not support phone alerts on the international site (alibabacloud.com). You can configure alert rules for DTS tasks only in the CloudMonitor console
parameters.help_zh:
异常报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。

说明
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入 10 个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持通过云监控平台为 DTS 任务设置报警规则
parameters.name: error_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for triggering a latency alert. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. We recommend that you set the threshold to 10 seconds or more to avoid alert fluctuations caused by network issues or database loads.
This parameter is required when DelayAlertStatus is set to enable
parameters.help_zh:
触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。
当DelayAlertStatus取值为enable时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: delay_over_seconds

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号id，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
